Here is a medium-thorough report of what exists under `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot` for the HTML prototype, CSS, and related lore/style docs.

---

## 1) Exact file paths

**HTML / game shell**

**Related CSS (not the main AXEL skin)**

---

## 2) Key style choices, UX/visual conventions, and lore ideas

**Shared visual language (`styles.css`, `styles_game.css`, and the design docs)**
- **Palette:** Black ground (`#000` / near-black panels) with **blood red** `#ff0000` and **dark red** `#4a0000` as CSS variables; borders and glows use translucent red.
- **CRT / horror UI:** Full-screen `.scanlines` overlay (horizontal scan + subtle RGB stripe gradient); `.glitch-text` for memory beats; story text uses black shadow for readability; scene image can **shake** and **dim** during transitions (`scene-shake`, `scene-image-switch`).
- **Typography:** **VT323** is loaded in both HTML entry points and used heavily for UI, titles, and in-game copy. `styles.css` sets **Space Mono** on `body` and uses VT323 for headings and several controls; `styles_game.css` uses **VT323 for `body`** as well.
- **UX patterns (`game.html` + `styles_game.css`):** Centered game chrome (`max-width: 1200px`, `95vh`), **status bar** with `LOCATION`, memory count (`x/5`), inventory string; **uppercase** choice buttons in a **2-column grid** with variants for single/dense layouts; **portrait** rules enlarge tap targets; **home** control as a small framed “X”; **puzzle** flow: uppercase text field + ENTER; some choices get Tailwind classes (e.g. red border/text for basement). `user-select: none` and `overflow: hidden` on game body reduce accidental selection/scroll.
- **Marketing shell (`styles.css`):** Title screen with large letter-spaced **AXEL**, red neon-style glow on title, filmstrip of tall thumbs, image modal, content cards with background art from `pictures/`, comment form styled dark/red.

**Lore and worldbuilding (from `game.html` story object + `AXEL_analysis.md` / `AXEL_notes.md` / combat docs)**
- Return to a **decaying school** tied to **guilt**; friend **Axel** and themes of **abandonment, lying to police, suicide / burial in the basement**.
- **Hub:** locker as **sanctuary**; **map** with basement blacked out until ready.
- **Progress:** **five memories**; inventory-as-narrative flags (**Flashlight, Key, Shovel, Name**); speaking **“AXEL”** as the core puzzle/closure; **lighter** with name scratched; **cigarettes** as hint ritual and epilogue beat; multiple endings (fear, darkness, hell, convicted, true + epilogue).
- **Godot direction:** Top-down exploration + **separate combat** as guilt/rot “intrusion”; `AXEL_notes.md` positions combat as a large slice of playtime and ties areas to roguelite item themes.

---

## 3) Conflicting style guidance between files

| Topic | Conflict |
|--------|-----------|
| **Strict “two reds only” vs combat symbols** | `AXEL_analysis.md` states **no other hues** in the palette for sketches/UI language. `AXEL_combat_design.md` assigns **green / yellow / blue / red** low-tier symbols and multi-color princess mapping—fine as *symbol* language, but it contradicts a literal “only two reds” rule if read as global art direction. |
| **VT323 vs Space Mono** | `AXEL_analysis.md` and `AXEL_combat_design.md` prescribe **VT323 + Space Mono** (UI vs body). `styles_game.css` uses **VT323 for all body/UI**; `game.html` only loads **VT323** from Google Fonts. `exports\README.md` pushes **VT323 throughout**, which matches the game CSS more than the analysis line about Space Mono body. |
| **Tailwind vs custom reds** | `game.html` uses Tailwind utilities (`text-red-400`, `text-gray-400`, `text-sm`) for parts of the HUD. Those are **not** the same as `--blood-red` / `--dark-blood`, so status chrome can read slightly different from bespoke CSS. |
| **Title / branding** | `index.html` and most plans use **AXEL**. `exports\README.md` lists the title as **GUILT** in the overview block—naming inconsistency. |
| **Inventory counts** | `exports\README.md` says **three** key items (flashlight, key, name); the HTML also uses **shovel** and **Name** as separate mechanical needs—doc understates items. |
| **Play experience** | HTML prototype is **pure branching narrative**; `AXEL_notes.md` targets **60%+ combat** and heavy roguelite economy—same story IP, very different time/UX split. |
| **Language tone** | Nearly all player-facing story text is **English**; the wrong-answer branch in script uses a **Finnish** fallback string (`"Väärä vastaus..."`)—inconsistent localization. |
| **Moon Princess export CSS** | `game_history_styles.css` is **white backgrounds, black/gray borders, Oswald**—stylistically **orthogonal** to AXEL’s red-on-black CRT look if merged without reskinning. |
| **Missing HTML pages** | Nav advertises About/Credits/Contact files that **do not exist** beside `index.html`—broken IA relative to `AXEL_analysis.md`’s file list. |
